scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run dev --workspace=server"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
